simple.meaning: בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (Bêyth hâʼêtsel) is a Hebrew word meaning “Beth-ha-Etsel , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (H1018) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (H1018) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (Bêyth hâʼêtsel) / H1018 is traced through Micah 1:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
